data.title: 丛雨 · 溪流石桥边把脚丫浸入凉水时的惊喜轻呼
data.action: 坐在山涧朱红色小木桥边缘，双脚在清冽山溪里欢快地拍打水花，小手按在桥板上晃动身子
data.location: 千恋神社后山清凉透彻的林间高山溪流
data.lighting: 清晨山岚初散，金色朝阳穿透苍老杉树林，在朱红小桥与潺潺溪流上洒下斑驳暖光
data.mood: 天真烂漫、古灵精怪与神明少女的夏日欢歌
data.description: 远离山下暑气，深山溪水冰爽沁骨。身为神刀之灵的丛雨将小脚丫伸进哗哗流淌的溪水里，激起一串串晶亮的水珠，金黄双髻上的朱红发带欢快摇晃。她兴奋地晃着小腿，回过头向桥头的人大声招手——「吾之主人！快过来快过来！这里的溪水好凉快呀！丛雨的脚丫都要被小鱼啄痒啦，快下来陪丛雨一起踩水嘛！」
data.promptProse: Sitting along the edge of a vermilion wooden bridge spanning a clear mountain creek, Murasame wears a crisp white-and-crimson shrine-maiden swimdress with sheer shoulder frills and miniature rope waist cords. Splashing her bare feet happily through the sparkling stream, she grins cheerfully beneath dappled morning sunlight filtering through tall cedars.
data.animaCaption: Perched on the edge of a vermilion wooden bridge in her white-and-crimson shrine-maiden swimdress, she kicks her bare feet enthusiastically through the cold forest stream and laughs brightly toward the camera. Dappled morning sunlight sparkles across the rushing water.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a crisp snow-white and crimson shrine-maiden swimdress detailed with sheer shoulder frills, miniature rope waist cords, and tiny white paper tassels.
